name: Vaniyambadi

queries.query: Vaniyambadi official cadastral parcel map Tamil Nadu land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tamil Nadu Government land-record e-Services, the TamilNilam Geo-Info service of the Department of Survey and Settlement, TNGIS, and the official Vaniyambadi Municipality ward-map/revenue pages. No anonymous safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.result: Tamil-language first-party discovery identified the TamilNilam Geo-Info land-map service and Tamil Nadu government land-record/FMB services. The official descriptions indicate survey/subdivision and FMB visualization, but no public bounded parcel vector response was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Tamil Nadu Department of Survey and Settlement / TNeGA land-record services; Vaniyambadi Municipality is the local municipal revenue custodian.
registryEvidence.locality: Vaniyambadi Municipality, Tirupathur district, Tamil Nadu; official municipal pages document ward maps and a revenue branch.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: A state cadastral/FMB service and a local municipal map/revenue custodian are evidenced. This establishes a local registry/procedure, but not a public anonymous parcel API response or citywide geometry coverage.

parcelDiscovery.source: Tamil Nadu e-Services / TamilNilam Geo-Info / TNGIS and Vaniyambadi Municipality
parcelDiscovery.note: No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was observed, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Direct TLS-verified shell request timed out after 20 seconds. No login, retry bypass, or absence inference.
Direct shell request timed out after 20 seconds. Search inspection exposed an official ward-map page, but no parcel schema or geometry response was obtained.
First-party discovery exposed the municipal Revenue Branch and property-tax record role; this is custodial/procedural evidence, not cadastral parcel geometry.
Official TNGIS application catalog inspected; it describes GIS/land-information integration and warns that data are informational and dynamic, but no bounded anonymous parcel response was exposed.

Official Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System page retrieved over TLS; it describes links among RoR, cadastral FMB, and other land systems, but no public anonymous parcel vector endpoint was exposed.
Official TamilNilam Geo-Info listing states that map/FMB and survey-subdivision land records can be visualized; app listing is documentation only and yielded no safe parcel geometry response.

scopeLimits: The exact supplied WUP point [12.6819626789653, 78.6196020428714] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, or unusable UI was not treated as evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, registration detail, private token, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field was requested or retained.
No TLS verification was disabled and no source-specific certificate exception was used.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The municipal ward-map page is a local map/procedure route, but its current map payload was not reachable in the bounded shell request.
TamilNilam and e-Services documentation establishes FMB/cadastral capability, but current JavaScript/API configuration and a safe anonymous parcel response were not exposed.
Citywide availability, exact-point coverage, native identity field, CRS, and parcel geometry remain unverified.
